# MMK Library — Complete Catalog

Digital archive of the Moscow Methodological Circle (MMK).
207 Markdown full-text books, 219 scanned originals (PDF/DJVU), 8 audio lectures.
Period: 1959–2014. Language: Russian. License: CC BY-SA 4.0.

Repository: https://github.com/soviet-methodology/MMK_Library
Author: Maxim Osovsky (https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximosovsky/)

---

## Library Overview

- 204 book folders (one folder = one work)
- 207 Markdown full-text files in md/ (~16 MB)
- 123 PDF scans (~1.4 GB)
- 96 DJVU scans (~450 MB)
- 8 MP3 audio lectures (~360 MB)
- 196 HTML source captures from fondgp.ru (~240 MB)
- ~1.9 GB total

---

## How to Use

```bash
git clone https://github.com/soviet-methodology/MMK_Library.git
cd MMK_Library
grep -r "мыследеятельность" md/     # Full-text search across all books
```

Read any book: open md/*.md. Verify wording against scans in corresponding book folders.

---

## Related Archives

- [Voprosy Metodologii](https://github.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii) — digital archive of the journal *Вопросы методологии* (1991–1999): scans, OCR, tables of contents
- [Almanac Kentavr](https://github.com/maximosovsky/almanac-Kentavr) — digital archive of the almanac *Кентавр* (1990–2007): 40 issues with scans and searchable texts
